subject: functions in workspace missing in shiny

messages.author: f31d37e2299b0f79
messages.subject: functions in workspace missing in shiny
parts:
Hi,

I am relatively new to both RStudio and Shiny, which is probably why I cannot figure this problem out. I have made a shiny application that reads various objects and functions from the workspace, and it works like a charm when run locally IF the workspace is loaded prior to hitting runApp(myDirectory). However, after transferring the server.R, ui.R, and workspace to my account on the spark.rstudio site, one of the functions does not work (the error says one of the variables is not found), while everything else that accesses items in the workspace seems to run just fine. Could anyone hint at what the problem could be for being able to run this locally, but not on the spark.studio site? 

Thanks,

Veronica

messages.author: fa8b9dad524607ca
messages.subject: Re: functions in workspace missing in shiny
parts:
Have you considered saving the objects in your workspace to an .rda, rather than a .rdata, and load them as you need them? And I believe the functions can go in global.r or even server.r, though personally I keep them in a separate .r file and load them in with .source.

Outside of doing all of that, without seeing the exact details and running it myself, I can not think of why loading a workspace wouldn't work in your case.  But have you used the browser() function just above the code line which cannot find the variable automatically in order to see if you can manually validate its existence in the R session?
